condition_clusters.condition_label: Pleural, peritoneal, pericardial, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma with approved therapy context
condition_synonyms: Mesothelioma induction pre-surgery stage I epithelioid
condition_clusters.evidence: Mesothelioma - for treatment of pleural mesothelioma, peritoneal mesothelioma, pericardial mesothelioma, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma when any of the following criteria are met: a. As first-line therapy in combination with pemetrexed and either cisplatin or carboplatin, followed by single-agent maintenance bevacizumab; or b. As subsequent therapy in combination with pemetrexed and either cisplatin or carboplatin if immunotherapy was administered as first-line treatment; 2. For induction treatment ... when used in combination with pemetrexed and either cisplatin or carboplatin prior to surgical exploration for clinical stage I disease with epithelioid histology; 3. For treatment ... when used in combination with atezolizumab as subsequent therapy;
